package.name: MechFlow
package.description: A SOLIDWORKS-style workflow for FreeCAD: tabbed CommandManager, SOLIDWORKS-named feature dialogs (extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet, shell, patterns, Hole Wizard), sketch relations and status colours, drawings from parts, assembly mates, a Toolbox of standard parts (fasteners, EN and ASME flanges, pipe, fittings, bearings) that size themselves to holes and pipe ends, weldments (structural members, trim/extend, end caps, gussets, cut lists), sheet metal (with the SheetMetal Workbench), pipe routing (3D sketches, valves and instruments, your own library parts), drawing packs, exploded views, a supplier pack (PDF, STEP, DXF flats), a SimulationXpress-style stress check, Motion Study animations (keyframes, camera moves, MP4 export), Section View and rollback.

preferencepack.name: MechFlow
preferencepack.description: Navigation, units and view shortcuts that will feel familiar to SOLIDWORKS users.
